code-analysis-toolkit 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Pro enterprise edition.
- Adds advanced Git history analysis for teams, including mandatory consent management, team retrospectives, and audit logs.
- Supports multi-repository batch scanning and aggregate reporting.
- Enables historical trend tracking and baseline comparison.
- Offers anonymized reporting and enhanced privacy features.
- Full backward compatibility with the free edition and includes priority support.
